finance.costs_breakdown_note: Official Nazarbayev University undergraduate tuition for the 2026/2027 academic year published in USD ($15,000 per year for both domestic and international self-funded students across undergraduate schools). Optional campus living costs are estimated by the university at approximately USD 400 per month but omitted from the breakdown per UniSearch contract rules.

records.description: Official materials describe Nazarbayev University as a public research university in Astana, established in 2010, with undergraduate, graduate and professional schools across engineering, sciences, medicine, business, education and public policy.

factors_meta.method: Deterministic mapping from OpenAlex (research metrics), Open-Meteo geocoding/Wikidata (city population), official QS rank metadata where available, and tuition. Social/academic intensity is a UniSearch proxy signal, not an official university metric. Location axis is computed as city-life(0.0) <-> outside-major-city(1.0).

admission_categories.label: Regular undergraduate admission
admission_categories.description: Nazarbayev University undergraduate admission category with SAT, ACT, and NUET requirement profiles.
extra_requirements: Online application submitted via the Nazarbayev University Admissions Portal (admissions.nu.edu.kz)
Application fee: 10,000 KZT for citizens of Kazakhstan / USD 30–50 for international applicants (paid online)

Standardized test results: SAT minimum score 1240 (Math 600+ recommended for SEDS; code 7915) or ACT minimum composite score 26 (Math 24+; code 5480); or NUET (Nazarbayev University Entrance Test) minimum 120 (Math 60+)

English language proficiency: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in Writing, 5.5 in Listening/Reading/Speaking) or TOEFL iBT 79 (Writing 22+). For NUET route: IELTS 6.0 (Writing 6.0, other bands 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 60
Secondary school graduation certificate (attestat) or IB/A-Level diploma with academic transcript (minimum GPA 3.0 out of 4.0 or equivalent)
Motivation letter in English explaining academic background, extracurricular leadership, and intellectual goals
Two confidential letters of recommendation from high school subject teachers submitted directly online
Scanned copy of applicant passport or national identity document
